verdict.rationale: Typesense is a self-hostable server distributed as Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes, Linux binary, DEB/RPM packages, and a Terraform module. Its docs include dedicated sections on running tests with Testcontainers and in GitHub Actions, and a probe found an official CLI documented on the install page, so it plainly runs headlessly in CI for automation. Missing for 10: the evidence contains only CI guide section titles rather than detailed content (e.g. workflow configuration), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of Typesense running in CI pipelines.
